summary: MODERN AND SPACIOUS ONE BEDROOM APARTMENT Located in Stockton, less than 2 miles from North Tees Hospital and with easy access to the A19. Close to local shops and amenities. The apartment block has parking spaces available (subject to an extra charge) and a lift to all four floors. Property comprises of - entrance hallway, large living room, modern fitted kitchen (no white goods provided), double bedroom, bathroom with shower. Electric heating. All rooms are fully accessible and some have wet rooms available. MARKETING PHOTOS ARE VIRTUALLY STAGES FOR MARKETING PURPOSES
